cond_0001.intro: This job uses advanced and predictive data analytics using machine learning and artificial intelligence technology for healthcare innovation and outcomes. Performs analysis using data science techniques on structured and unstructured data sets and develops algorithms for targeted business needs. Pilots the delivery of patient-centered and personalized advanced analytics solutions that improve contract performance, program effectiveness, and clinical, financial, and utilization outcomes across the continuum of care. Implements advanced scientific techniques, forecasting, and machine learning to predict financial and clinical outcomes in order to guide investments that improve health outcomes and reduce costs.
cond_0001.responsibilities: Leads the design and deployment of computational algorithms, statistical methods, and predictive models. Uses machine learning techniques and statistical test, including Pearson correlation, Ttests and Anova statistical tests, for hypothesis testing to assess outcomes of interventions and clinical program. Uses supervised and unsupervised machine learning techniques such as regression, random forest, xgboost, clustering or causal inference techniques, such as hierarchical modeling and propensity score matching, to deliver analytics solutions and researches new methods to evaluate, improve and implement machine learning models to be used in clinical, operational, and corporate areas. Follows best practices for data science and software development (version control, testing, containerization) to create deployable models and repeatable analyses. Heads the creation and dissemination of data mining approaches that facilitate rapid, streamlined detection of outliers, novel patterns of association, and latent, causal connections in high-dimensional data sets. Serve as quantitative subject matter expert (SME) and mentor to colleagues and teammates, providing guidance related to project/program design, statistical methodology, model input/output selection, and interpretation of results. Works directly and maintains a relationship with aligned business partners in requirements definition, project scoping, timeline management, and documentation. Fosters relationships with internal and external stakeholders through regular engagement, communication, and consistent delivery of analytic work products. Authors technical reports, statistical analysis plans (SAP), white papers, enterprise presentations, and peer-reviewed abstracts, posters, and journal articles. Collaborates with data management team to identify required data assets and, in turn, to automate their sourcing, integration, and analysis. Performs other related duties as assigned.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or biomedical informatics.
24 Months in healthcare analytics, Data analyst, or graduate assistant.
At least 24 months coding in R, Python, SQL, or SAS.
Preferred Requirements
Ability to communicate and present data analytics concepts to a non-technical audience.
Experience presenting data analytics to laypeople orally and in writing.

It focuses on delivering patient-centered analytics solutions that support contract performance, program effectiveness, and clinical, financial, and utilization outcomes. The work involves forecasting and machine learning to predict financial and clinical outcomes in order to guide investments that improve health outcomes and reduce costs.
cond_0079.responsibilities:
Lead the design and deployment of computational algorithms, statistical methods, and predictive models.
Apply machine learning techniques and statistical tests, including Pearson correlation, T-tests, and ANOVA, for hypothesis testing to assess outcomes of interventions and clinical programs.
Use supervised and unsupervised machine learning techniques such as regression, random forest, xgboost, and clustering, as well as causal inference techniques such as hierarchical modeling and propensity score matching, to deliver analytics solutions. Research and implement new methods to evaluate and improve machine learning models for clinical, operational, and corporate use.
Follow best practices for data science and software development (version control, testing, containerization) to produce deployable models and repeatable analyses.
Lead the creation and documentation of data mining approaches that support detection of outliers, novel patterns of association, and latent causal connections in high-dimensional data sets.
Serve as quantitative subject matter expert (SME) and provide guidance to colleagues on project and program design, statistical methodology, model input/output selection, and interpretation of results.
Coordinate with aligned business partners on requirements definition, project scoping, timeline management, and documentation.
Maintain working relationships with internal and external stakeholders through consistent delivery of analytic work products and task-specific communication.
Produce technical reports, statistical analysis plans (SAP), white papers, and peer-reviewed abstracts, posters, and journal articles.
Coordinate with the data management team to identify required data assets and support their sourcing, integration, and analysis.
Perform other related duties as assigned.
Travel to [Location masked] worksite as required by project needs.
cond_0079.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or Biomedical Informatics
At least 24 months of experience in healthcare analytics, data analysis, or as a graduate assistant
At least 24 months of coding experience in R, Python, SQL, or SAS
Preferred Requirements
Ability to communicate data analytics concepts clearly to non-technical audiences, both orally and in writing

Pilots the delivery of patient-centered and personalized advanced analytics solutions that improve contract performance, program effectiveness, and clinical, financial, and utilization outcomes across the continuum of care. Implements advanced scientific techniques, forecasting, and machine learning to predict financial and clinical outcomes in order to guide investments that improve health outcomes and reduce costs.
cond_0111.responsibilities: Leads the design and deployment of computational algorithms, statistical methods, and predictive models. Uses machine learning techniques and statistical test, including Pearson correlation, Ttests and Anova statistical tests, for hypothesis testing to assess outcomes of interventions and clinical program. Uses supervised and unsupervised machine learning techniques such as regression, random forest, xgboost, clustering or causal inference techniques, such as hierarchical modeling and propensity score matching, to deliver analytics solutions and researches new methods to evaluate, improve and implement machine learning models to be used in clinical, operational, and corporate areas. Follows best practices for data science and software development (version control, testing, containerization) to create deployable models and repeatable analyses. Heads the creation and dissemination of data mining approaches that facilitate rapid, streamlined detection of outliers, novel patterns of association, and latent, causal connections in high-dimensional data sets. Serve as quantitative subject matter expert (SME) and mentor to colleagues and teammates, providing guidance related to project/program design, statistical methodology, model input/output selection, and interpretation of results. Works directly and maintains a relationship with aligned business partners in requirements definition, project scoping, timeline management, and documentation. Fosters relationships with internal and external stakeholders through regular engagement, communication, and consistent delivery of analytic work products. Authors technical reports, statistical analysis plans (SAP), white papers, enterprise presentations, and peer-reviewed abstracts, posters, and journal articles. Collaborates with data management team to identify required data assets and, in turn, to automate their sourcing, integration, and analysis. Performs other related duties as assigned. Travel as needed to [Location masked] worksite 1 or 2 times per month, or more depending on the needs of the work.
cond_0111.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or biomedical informatics, or a related field — equivalent practical experience will also be considered.
Around 24 months of experience in healthcare analytics, as a data analyst, or as a graduate assistant, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Around 24 months of coding experience in R, Python, SQL, or SAS — candidates still building fluency in one or more of these are welcome to apply.
Preferred Requirements
Ability to communicate and present data analytics concepts to a non-technical audience, both orally and in writing — this is a skill that can be developed on the job.
Some background in presenting analytical findings to non-specialist audiences is a plus, though we value the willingness to grow in this area.

cond_0163.intro: This job uses advanced and predictive data analytics using machine learning and artificial intelligence technology for healthcare innovation and outcomes. Performs analysis using data science techniques on structured and unstructured data sets and develops algorithms for targeted business needs. Pilots the delivery of patient-centered and personalized advanced analytics solutions that improve contract performance, program effectiveness, and clinical, financial, and utilization outcomes across the continuum of care. Implements advanced scientific techniques, forecasting, and machine learning to predict financial and clinical outcomes in order to guide investments that improve health outcomes and reduce costs.
cond_0163.responsibilities: Leads the design and deployment of computational algorithms, statistical methods, and predictive models. Uses machine learning techniques and statistical test, including Pearson correlation, Ttests and Anova statistical tests, for hypothesis testing to assess outcomes of interventions and clinical program. Uses supervised and unsupervised machine learning techniques such as regression, random forest, xgboost, clustering or causal inference techniques, such as hierarchical modeling and propensity score matching, to deliver analytics solutions and researches new methods to evaluate, improve and implement machine learning models to be used in clinical, operational, and corporate areas. Follows best practices for data science and software development (version control, testing, containerization) to create deployable models and repeatable analyses. Heads the creation and dissemination of data mining approaches that facilitate rapid, streamlined detection of outliers, novel patterns of association, and latent, causal connections in high-dimensional data sets. Serve as quantitative subject matter expert (SME) and mentor to colleagues and teammates, providing guidance related to project/program design, statistical methodology, model input/output selection, and interpretation of results. Works directly and maintains a relationship with aligned business partners in requirements definition, project scoping, timeline management, and documentation. Fosters relationships with internal and external stakeholders through regular engagement, communication, and consistent delivery of analytic work products. Authors technical reports, statistical analysis plans (SAP), white papers, enterprise presentations, and peer-reviewed abstracts, posters, and journal articles. Collaborates with data management team to identify required data assets and, in turn, to automate their sourcing, integration, and analysis. Performs other related duties as assigned.

cond_0276.intro: We are looking for a Data Scientist to join our team. This role uses advanced and predictive data analytics, machine learning, and AI for healthcare innovation and outcomes. You will analyze structured and unstructured data, develop algorithms for targeted business needs, and deliver patient-centered analytics solutions that improve contract performance, program effectiveness, and clinical, financial, and utilization outcomes. The work involves regular collaboration with business partners, stakeholders, and colleagues across the organization.
cond_0276.responsibilities:
Leads the design and deployment of computational algorithms, statistical methods, and predictive models.
Uses machine learning techniques and statistical tests, including Pearson correlation, T-tests, and ANOVA, for hypothesis testing to assess outcomes of interventions and clinical programs.
Uses supervised and unsupervised machine learning techniques such as regression, random forest, xgboost, clustering, or causal inference techniques such as hierarchical modeling and propensity score matching, to deliver analytics solutions. Researches new methods to evaluate, improve, and implement machine learning models for clinical, operational, and corporate use.
Follows best practices for data science and software development (version control, testing, containerization) to create deployable models and repeatable analyses.
Heads the creation and dissemination of data mining approaches that facilitate rapid, streamlined detection of outliers, novel patterns of association, and latent, causal connections in high-dimensional data sets.
Serves as quantitative subject matter expert (SME) and mentor to colleagues and teammates, actively providing guidance on project and program design, statistical methodology, model input/output selection, and interpretation of results.
Works directly and maintains ongoing relationships with aligned business partners in requirements definition, project scoping, timeline management, and documentation.
Fosters relationships with internal and external stakeholders through regular engagement, communication, and consistent delivery of analytic work products.
Authors technical reports, statistical analysis plans (SAP), white papers, enterprise presentations, and peer-reviewed abstracts, posters, and journal articles.
Collaborates daily with the data management team to identify required data assets and to automate their sourcing, integration, and analysis.
Performs other related duties as assigned.
cond_0276.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or Biomedical Informatics
24 Months of experience in healthcare analytics, data analysis, or as a graduate assistant
At least 24 months of coding experience in R, Python, SQL, or SAS
Preferred Requirements
Ability to communicate and present data analytics concepts clearly to a non-technical audience, both orally and in writing

cond_0296.intro: We are looking for a Data Scientist to join our team. This role applies advanced and predictive data analytics using machine learning and AI for healthcare innovation and outcomes. You will execute analysis on structured and unstructured data, build algorithms for targeted business needs, and take ownership of delivering patient-centered advanced analytics solutions that improve contract performance, program effectiveness, and clinical, financial, and utilization outcomes. You will drive the application of scientific techniques, forecasting, and machine learning to predict financial and clinical outcomes and guide investments that improve health outcomes and reduce costs.
cond_0296.responsibilities:
Leads the design and deployment of computational algorithms, statistical methods, and predictive models.
Directs the use of machine learning techniques and statistical tests, including Pearson correlation, T-tests, and ANOVA, for hypothesis testing to assess outcomes of interventions and clinical programs.
Executes supervised and unsupervised machine learning techniques such as regression, random forest, xgboost, clustering, or causal inference techniques such as hierarchical modeling and propensity score matching, to deliver analytics solutions; proactively researches new methods to evaluate, improve, and implement machine learning models for clinical, operational, and corporate use.
Ensures best practices for data science and software development (version control, testing, containerization) to create deployable models and repeatable analyses.
Heads the creation and dissemination of data mining approaches that enable rapid, streamlined detection of outliers, novel patterns of association, and latent, causal connections in high-dimensional data sets.
Serves as quantitative subject matter expert (SME) and mentor to colleagues and teammates, providing guidance on project/program design, statistical methodology, model input/output selection, and interpretation of results.
Owns relationships with aligned business partners in requirements definition, project scoping, timeline management, and documentation.
Drives engagement with internal and external stakeholders through regular communication and consistent delivery of analytic work products.
Authors technical reports, statistical analysis plans (SAP), white papers, enterprise presentations, and peer-reviewed abstracts, posters, and journal articles.
Leads coordination with the data management team to identify required data assets and automate their sourcing, integration, and analysis.
Performs other related duties as assigned.
Travels as needed to [Location masked] worksite 1 or 2 times per month, or more depending on the needs of the work.

cond_0328.intro: This role uses advanced and predictive data analytics — including machine learning and AI — to support healthcare innovation and outcomes. It involves analysis on structured and unstructured data sets, developing algorithms for specific business needs, and delivering patient-centered analytics solutions that improve contract performance, program effectiveness, and clinical, financial, and utilization outcomes. The role also applies forecasting and machine learning to predict financial and clinical outcomes and guide investments that improve health and reduce costs. People who do well in this kind of role are often quick to see the logic of the analytical and clinical problems the work involves.
cond_0328.responsibilities:
Leads the design and deployment of computational algorithms, statistical methods, and predictive models.
Uses machine learning techniques and statistical tests, including Pearson correlation, T-tests and ANOVA, for hypothesis testing to assess outcomes of interventions and clinical programs.
Uses supervised and unsupervised machine learning techniques such as regression, random forest, xgboost, clustering, or causal inference techniques such as hierarchical modeling and propensity score matching, to deliver analytics solutions and researches new methods to evaluate, improve, and implement machine learning models for clinical, operational, and corporate use.
Follows best practices for data science and software development (version control, testing, containerization) to create deployable models and repeatable analyses.
Leads the creation and dissemination of data mining approaches that facilitate rapid detection of outliers, novel patterns of association, and latent, causal connections in high-dimensional data sets.
Serves as quantitative subject matter expert (SME) and mentor to colleagues and teammates, providing guidance on project/program design, statistical methodology, model input/output selection, and interpretation of results.
Works directly with aligned business partners on requirements definition, project scoping, timeline management, and documentation.
Fosters relationships with internal and external stakeholders through regular engagement, communication, and consistent delivery of analytic work products.
Authors technical reports, statistical analysis plans (SAP), white papers, enterprise presentations, and peer-reviewed abstracts, posters, and journal articles.
Collaborates with data management team to identify required data assets and to automate their sourcing, integration, and analysis.
Performs other related duties as assigned.
Travel as needed to [Location masked] worksite 1 or 2 times per month, or more depending on the needs of the work.
cond_0328.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or Biomedical Informatics
24 Months of experience in healthcare analytics, data analysis, or as a graduate assistant
At least 24 months of coding experience in R, Python, SQL, or SAS
Preferred Requirements
Ability to communicate and present data analytics concepts to a non-technical audience
Experience presenting data analytics to laypeople both orally and in writing

Coordinate with cross-functional teams on the design and deployment of computational algorithms, statistical methods, and predictive models. Apply machine learning techniques and statistical tests, including Pearson correlation, T-tests and ANOVA, for hypothesis testing to assess outcomes of interventions and clinical programs. Work alongside analytics partners using supervised and unsupervised machine learning techniques such as regression, random forest, xgboost, clustering, or causal inference techniques such as hierarchical modeling and propensity score matching, to deliver analytics solutions; share findings on new methods to evaluate, improve, and implement machine learning models for clinical, operational, and corporate areas. Follow best practices for data science and software development (version control, testing, containerization) to create deployable models and repeatable analyses. Collaborate on the creation and dissemination of data mining approaches that support rapid, streamlined detection of outliers, novel patterns of association, and latent, causal connections in high-dimensional data sets. Serve as a quantitative subject matter expert (SME) and provide guidance to colleagues and teammates on project/program design, statistical methodology, model input/output selection, and interpretation of results. Work directly with aligned business partners on requirements definition, project scoping, timeline management, and documentation. Maintain regular engagement with internal and external stakeholders through consistent communication and delivery of analytic work products. Co-author technical reports, statistical analysis plans (SAP), white papers, enterprise presentations, and peer-reviewed abstracts, posters, and journal articles. Work with the data management team to identify required data assets and help automate their sourcing, integration, and analysis. Perform other related duties as assigned. Travel as needed to [Location masked] worksite 1 or 2 times per month, or more depending on the needs of the work.

cond_0413.intro: We are looking for a Data Scientist to join our team. This role owns the application of advanced and predictive data analytics using machine learning and artificial intelligence for healthcare innovation and outcomes. You will execute analysis using data science techniques on structured and unstructured data sets and develop algorithms for targeted business needs. You will drive the delivery of patient-centered advanced analytics solutions that improve contract performance, program effectiveness, and clinical, financial, and utilization outcomes across the continuum of care. You will apply advanced scientific techniques, forecasting, and machine learning to predict financial and clinical outcomes and guide investments that improve health outcomes and reduce costs.

Leads the design and deployment of computational algorithms, statistical methods, and predictive models.

Heads the creation and dissemination of data mining approaches that facilitate rapid, streamlined detection of outliers, novel patterns of association, and latent, causal connections in high-dimensional data sets.
Serves as quantitative subject matter expert (SME) and mentor to colleagues and teammates, providing guidance on project/program design, statistical methodology, model input/output selection, and interpretation of results.
Owns relationships with aligned business partners in requirements definition, project scoping, timeline management, and documentation.
Drives engagement with internal and external stakeholders through regular communication and consistent delivery of analytic work products.
Authors technical reports, statistical analysis plans (SAP), white papers, enterprise presentations, and peer-reviewed abstracts, posters, and journal articles.
Leads coordination with the data management team to identify required data assets and automate their sourcing, integration, and analysis.
Performs other related duties as assigned.
Remains knowledgeable on current federal, state and local laws, accreditation standards or regulatory agency requirements that apply to the assigned area of responsibility and ensures compliance with all such laws, regulations and standards.

Physical and Environmental Demands
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
Sedentary Work - Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally (Occasionally: activity or condition exists up to 1/3 of the time) and/or a negligible amount of force frequently (Frequently: activity or condition exists from 1/3 to 2/3 of the time) to lift, carry, push, pull, or otherwise move objects. Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time but may involve walking or standing for brief periods of time. Jobs are sedentary if walking and standing are required only occasionally and all other sedentary criteria are met.
Normal routine involves no exposure to blood, body fluid or tissue and as part of their employment, incumbents are not called upon to perform or assist in emergency care or first aid.

Pilots the delivery of patient-centered and personalized advanced analytics solutions that improve contract performance, program effectiveness, and clinical, financial, and utilization outcomes across the continuum of care. Implements advanced scientific techniques, forecasting, and machine learning to predict financial and clinical outcomes in order to guide investments that improve health outcomes and reduce costs.
cond_0507.responsibilities: Leads the design and deployment of computational algorithms, statistical methods, and predictive models. Uses machine learning techniques and statistical test, including Pearson correlation, Ttests and Anova statistical tests, for hypothesis testing to assess outcomes of interventions and clinical program. Uses supervised and unsupervised machine learning techniques such as regression, random forest, xgboost, clustering or causal inference techniques, such as hierarchical modeling and propensity score matching, to deliver analytics solutions and researches new methods to evaluate, improve and implement machine learning models to be used in clinical, operational, and corporate areas. Follows best practices for data science and software development (version control, testing, containerization) to create deployable models and repeatable analyses. Heads the creation and dissemination of data mining approaches that facilitate rapid, streamlined detection of outliers, novel patterns of association, and latent, causal connections in high-dimensional data sets. Serve as quantitative subject matter expert (SME) and mentor to colleagues and teammates, providing guidance related to project/program design, statistical methodology, model input/output selection, and interpretation of results. Works directly and maintains a relationship with aligned business partners in requirements definition, project scoping, timeline management, and documentation. Fosters relationships with internal and external stakeholders through regular engagement, communication, and consistent delivery of analytic work products. Authors technical reports, statistical analysis plans (SAP), white papers, enterprise presentations, and peer-reviewed abstracts, posters, and journal articles. Collaborates with data management team to identify required data assets and, in turn, to automate their sourcing, integration, and analysis. Performs other related duties as assigned. Travel as needed to [Location masked] worksite 1 or 2 times per month, or more depending on the needs of the work.
cond_0507.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or biomedical informatics, or a related field — equivalent practical experience will also be considered.
Around 24 months of experience in healthcare analytics, as a data analyst, or as a graduate assistant, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Around 24 months of coding experience in R, Python, SQL, or SAS — candidates still building fluency in one or more of these are welcome to apply.
Preferred Requirements
Ability to communicate and present data analytics concepts to a non-technical audience, both orally and in writing — this is a skill that can be developed on the job.
Some background in presenting analytical findings to non-specialist audiences is a plus, though we value the willingness to grow in this area.
